extracted.name: Mushrooms with a Soy Sauce Glaze
extracted.description: These mushrooms with soy sauce and garlic glaze are so quick and easy to make. They are simply delicious with pork chops, steak, or salmon!
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms; cook and stir until mushrooms have softened and released their liquid, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic; continue to cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in soy sauce; cook until liquid has evaporated, about 4 minutes.
